title: Cancellation Policy Schedule, In-Stay and Charge-Component Settings — Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Cancellation Policy Schedule — in-stay cancellations and charge-component settings

This part of the schedule for the Stays (Guest Reservations) category records, for each of the eight cancellation policies, the settings that apply when a guest cancels after check-in and the settings that govern each charge component of a guest-cancellation refund.

## Cancellations after check-in, by policy

| Cancellation policy | Refund of unspent nights after the notice nights | Notice nights forfeited |
|---|---|---|
| Flexible | 100.00% | 1 |
| Moderate | 50.00% | 1 |
| Limited | 0.00% | 0 |
| Firm | 0.00% | 0 |
| Strict | 0.00% | 0 |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 0.00% | 0 |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 0.00% | 0 |
| Long-Term | 100.00% | 30 |

- **Refund of unspent nights after the notice nights** — the percent of the unspent nights, after the notice nights, that is refunded when the guest cancels after check-in.
- **Notice nights forfeited** — the unspent nights forfeited as notice when the guest cancels after check-in.

## Settings shared by all eight policies

Each of the following is set identically for Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Which nights count as unspent on a cancellation after check-in | nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date |
| How one night's price is derived for any per-night refund | the nightly subtotal divided by the nights, rounded half up to the cent |
| Cleaning fee refunded in full on any standard-rate guest cancellation dated before the check-in date | Yes |
| Cleaning fee refunded on a guest cancellation dated on or after the check-in date | No |
| Pet fee and extra-guest fee refunded in the same proportion as the nightly subtotal | Yes |
| Guest service fee refunded in full when the cancellation falls in the full-refund window or the booking grace period | Yes |
| How the guest service fee is refunded outside the full-refund window | proportional |
| How the occupancy tax is refunded | proportional — in the same proportion as the refunded taxable base |

## Illustration (hypothetical stay)

A hypothetical 6-night stay has a nightly subtotal of 900.00. One night's price is 900.00 divided by 6, which is 150.00. If the guest cancels after check-in with 3 nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date, those 3 nights are the unspent nights. Under Flexible, 1 of them is forfeited as notice and 100.00% of the other 2 is refunded; under Moderate, 1 is forfeited and 50.00% of the other 2 is refunded; under Limited, none is forfeited as notice and 0.00% is refunded.
